note: Laya tool schema v1 (design doc, 'Tools (schema v1)'). Ships in the model bundle; the manifest's tool_schema_version must match schema_version. Single source of truth for the app, the evals and constrained decoding (ml/bundle/tool_schema.py builds the UNDERSTAND output JSON Schema from it).

scan_image.description: Open the camera to photograph and diagnose a leaf.

field_id.description: Field to attach the scan to (an id from the context).

get_scan_history.description: List past scans and their diagnoses.

field_id.description: Only this field (an id from the context).

compare_scans.description: Compare two scans to see if a problem is getting better or worse.

scan_a.description: Older scan id from the context.

scan_b.description: Newer scan id from the context.

get_treatment_info.description: Verified treatment and prevention for a diagnosed problem, from the knowledge base.

get_weather.description: Weather forecast, e.g. to decide when to spray.

location.description: Place name, usually the farm's location from the context.

record_observation.description: Save a note about the crop (needs a confirmation tap).

text.description: The note, in the farmer's words.

create_reminder.description: Set a reminder (needs a confirmation tap).
